Goblin Guide.name: Goblin Guide
Goblin Guide.oracle_text: Haste. Whenever Goblin Guide attacks, defending player reveals the top card of their library. If it's a land card, that player puts it into their hand.

Monastery Swiftspear.name: Monastery Swiftspear
Monastery Swiftspear.oracle_text: Haste. Prowess (Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.)

Ash Zealot.name: Ash Zealot
Ash Zealot.oracle_text: First strike, haste. Whenever Ash Zealot deals combat damage to a player, exile the top card of that player's graveyard.

Hellrider.name: Hellrider
Hellrider.oracle_text: Haste. Whenever a creature you control attacks, Hellrider deals 1 damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.

Lightning Bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
Lightning Bolt.oracle_text: Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage to any target.

Shock.name: Shock
Shock.oracle_text: Shock deals 2 damage to any target.

Lava Spike.name: Lava Spike
Lava Spike.oracle_text: Lava Spike deals 3 damage to target player or planeswalker.

Wild Slash.name: Wild Slash
Wild Slash.oracle_text: Wild Slash deals 2 damage to any target. This spell can't be countered by spells.

Eidolon of the Great Revel.name: Eidolon of the Great Revel
Eidolon of the Great Revel.oracle_text: Whenever a player casts a noncreature spell, Eidolon of the Great Revel deals 2 damage to that player.

Skullcrack.name: Skullcrack
Skullcrack.oracle_text: Skullcrack deals 3 damage to target player or planeswalker. That player or that planeswalker's controller can't gain life for the rest of the turn.

Searing Blood.name: Searing Blood
Searing Blood.oracle_text: Searing Blood deals 2 damage to target creature. If that creature would die this turn, Searing Blood deals 3 damage to that creature's controller.

Smash to Smithereens.name: Smash to Smithereens
Smash to Smithereens.oracle_text: Destroy target artifact. Smash to Smithereens deals 3 damage to that artifact's controller.

Merfolk Looter.name: Merfolk Looter
Merfolk Looter.oracle_text: {T}: Draw a card, then discard a card.

Man-o'-War.name: Man-o'-War
Man-o'-War.oracle_text: When Man-o'-War enters the battlefield, return target creature to its owner's hand.

Aven Fisher.name: Aven Fisher
Aven Fisher.oracle_text: Flying. When Aven Fisher enters the battlefield, draw a card.

Mana Leak.name: Mana Leak
Mana Leak.oracle_text: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {3}.

Unsummon.name: Unsummon
Unsummon.oracle_text: Return target creature to its owner's hand.

Vapor Snag.name: Vapor Snag
Vapor Snag.oracle_text: Return target creature to its owner's hand. Its owner loses 1 life.

Frost Breath.name: Frost Breath
Frost Breath.oracle_text: Tap up to two target creatures. Put a stun counter on each of them. (If a permanent with a stun counter would become untapped, remove one from it instead.)
